filing_office: Pennsylvania Department of State, Bureau of Corporations and Charitable Organizations
formation_document_name: Certificate of Organization (DSCB:15-8821), with Docketing Statement (DSCB:15-134A)
filing_fee_notes: Base formation fee. The form provides a qualifying veteran/reservist-owned small-business fee exemption.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a Pennsylvania registered office with a street address; a P.O. box alone is insufficient. A contracted Commercial Registered Office Provider may be used instead. Public designation of a registered agent is not required.
standard_processing_time: The Department's business FAQ says to allow 15 business days.
expedite_options: Additional 100 for same-day service before 10 a.m., 300 for three-hour service before 2 p.m., or 1000 for one-hour service before 4 p.m. Expedited requests are not accepted by mail.
annual_report_due: September 30, beginning the year after formation.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Pennsylvania Department of Labor & Industry, Office of Unemployment Compensation Tax Services
plain_english_summary: File a Certificate of Organization and maintain a Pennsylvania registered office. File an annual report by September 30 starting the next year.
common_mistake: Do not rely on the old decennial reporting schedule; LLC annual reports began in 2025.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic for-profit LLC. LLCs with a not-for-profit purpose have no annual report fee. Restricted professional companies have a separate annual registration obligation that the Annual Report does not replace. The processing time is the general business FAQ allowance. Franchise or privilege tax treatment, publication requirements and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
